rationale: Fujia Zhang brings deep hardware expertise in solar and storage systems for infrastructure, while THOTA VENKATA SEETHA RAM MOHAN has hands-on PLC engineering and industrial automation experience at Hitachi with a strong hardware-RTL background. Their complementary skills in hardware engineering and automation controls create potential for exploring how control systems and hardware synthesis could enhance distributed energy solutions.
intro_message: Fujia Zhang, meet THOTA VENKATA SEETHA RAM MOHAN — you both work at the hardware-infrastructure intersection and could explore how PLC automation and RTL design might apply to solar and microgrid deployments.
